PLIGHT.gloss: a situation from which extrication is difficult especially an unpleasant or trying one
PLIGHT.definition: A situation from which extrication is difficult especially an unpleasant or trying one.
PLIGHT.example: Finds himself in a most awkward predicament.

LIGHT.gloss: electromagnetic radiation that can produce a visual sensation
LIGHT.definition: (physics) electromagnetic radiation that can produce a visual sensation.
LIGHT.example: The light was filtered through a soft glass window.

GILT.gloss: having the deep slightly brownish color of gold
GILT.definition: Having the deep slightly brownish color of gold.

HILT.gloss: the handle of a sword or dagger
HILT.definition: The handle of a sword or dagger.

TIP.definition: The extreme end of something; especially something pointed.

PIT.definition: A sizeable hole (usually in the ground).
PIT.example: They dug a pit to bury the body.

HIP.gloss: either side of the body below the waist and above the thigh
HIP.definition: Either side of the body below the waist and above the thigh.

LIP.gloss: either of two fleshy folds of tissue that surround the mouth and play a role in speaking
LIP.definition: Either of two fleshy folds of tissue that surround the mouth and play a role in speaking.
